title: Extract mtk_root together with the libraries that live outside it
objective: Move the MediaTek rooting toolkit to its own public repo. Unlike the three app extractions, mtk_root's libraries and half its test suites live in linux_configuration/scripts/lib/, one directory up. Extracting the directory alone would orphan eight files here and leave the new repo unable to source anything.
acceptance_criteria: The new repo preserves the mtk_root/ + lib/ sibling layout, so every `source "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/..."` resolves without editing a single call site.
All 84 mtk tests pass from a clean clone of the new repo.
shellcheck exits 0 over every script in the new repo with no severity filter, which requires carrying .shellcheckrc across.
The new repo has its own lib/tests/run_all.sh, because the monorepo's is shared with a non-mtk suite and must stay.
The suite remaining in the monorepo still passes: removing a shared fixture must not take test_common_datetime.sh down with it.
meta/shell-coverage-allowlist.txt has no entry naming a removed path.
out_of_scope: single_use/utils/lib/bl9000_*.sh, which is separate Android rooting tooling that merely mentions mtkclient.
Renaming mtk_harness.sh, whose name is now historical but whose one consumer would churn for no behavioural gain.
Verifying the toolkit against real hardware, which READY.md already records as pending.
verifier: ./lib/tests/run_all.sh in the new repo reports 84 passed / 0 failed; shellcheck over the new repo exits 0; ./linux_configuration/scripts/lib/tests/run_all.sh here reports 55 passed / 0 failed; bash meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh --all exits 0; gh confirms the repo is public on main.
